## LoginPage
- **Import:** `../pages/generalPages/loginPage.js`
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:**
  - `userIdInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-user-id-field"]`
  - `passwordInput` — selector: `[data-test="login-password-field"]`
  - `loginButton` — selector: `[data-test="login-sign-in"]`
  - `userIdError` — selector: `[data-test="login-user-id-error"]`
  - `passwordError` — selector: `[data-test="login-password-error"]`
- **Methods:**
  - `fillLoginForm(email, password)` — fills userIdInput and passwordInput
  - `submitLoginForm()` — clicks loginButton
  - `login()` — full login flow; ⏱ timing-aware: waitForTimeout(1000ms + 2000ms) 🌐 network-aware: waitForResponse('/auth/login')
  - `openInternalLoginForm()` — navigates to login page and waits for form visibility
  - `gotoLoginPage()` — navigates to process.env["ZO_BASE_URL"]
  - `loginAsInternalUser()` — clicks Login as internal user link if visible

## TracesPage
- **Import:** `../pages/tracesPages/tracesPage.js`
- **Iframe:** top-level page
- **Properties:**
  - `searchToggle` — selector: `[data-test="traces-search-mode-traces-btn"]`
  - `spansToggle` — selector: `[data-test="traces-search-mode-spans-btn"]`
  - `tracesMenuItem` — selector: `[data-test="menu-link-\/traces-item"]`
  - `streamSelect` — selector: `[data-test="log-search-index-list-select-stream"]`
  - `searchResultItem` — selector for result rows
  - `resultNotFoundText` — selector: `[data-test="traces-search-result-not-found-text"]`
  - `errorMessage` — selector: `[data-test="traces-search-error-message"]`
- **Methods:**
  - `switchToSearchView()` — clicks searchToggle (Traces mode toggle)
  - `navigateToTraces()` — clicks tracesMenuItem with cloud fallback
  - `navigateToTracesUrl(orgName)` — navigates directly to traces URL using env var base URL
  - `runTraceSearch()` — clicks refresh button and waits for results
  - `selectTraceStream(streamName)` — selects a stream from the dropdown
